integrity: All analytic steps, domain restrictions and separate-in-method numerical checks are disclosed in RESULT.md and VERIFICATION.md. Primary scientific comparison distinguishes previously known generic wave existence/sign laws from the newly evaluated derivative. Self-review only; no independent external validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic smooth bistable PDE in one dimension on the infinite line, 0<a<1 and -1<b<=1. The sensitivity is local at b=0, not a monotonicity claim over all b; the wave-sign criterion holds across the admissible b interval. No finite-population extinction, finite-patch survival, curvature or multivariate parameter scaling is claimed. The 1996 Strier-Zanette-Wio full text and 2023 Tsai full primary text were not available; bibliographic residual risk is acknowledged.
